us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Republicans assess losses after midterm defeats
bullets: Republicans are reviewing what went wrong in 2026 midterm races.
Democrats expanded gains in Congress after the November 3 elections.
Party leaders face pressure over governing strategy and voter messaging.

articles.title: Trump Justice Department faces Democratic congressional scrutiny
bullets: A Democratic-led Congress is preparing oversight of the Justice Department.
AP reports lawmakers plan scrutiny of firings and politically charged investigations.
The department says its law-enforcement mission remains unchanged.

articles.title: US military says it downed two Iranian attack drones
bullets: The US military said it intercepted two Iranian attack drones.
Iran claimed a strike on a US radar system in Bahrain.
The incident followed escalating US-Iran tensions in the Gulf region.

articles.title: FBI says it seized $1.2 billion in stolen Binance cryptocurrency
bullets: The FBI announced a $1.2 billion cryptocurrency seizure.
Officials linked the funds to a major Binance theft last month.
The FBI previously attributed the heist to a North Korean hacking group.

articles.title: Democrats weigh next steps after strong election gains
bullets: Democrats are debating priorities after major midterm gains.
AP reported new attention on rebuilding party momentum nationally.
The results shifted focus toward Congress and the 2028 political map.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Top worldwide stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Global Microsoft outage disrupts governments and businesses
bullets: Microsoft said recovery work continued into a second day.
The outage affected email, workplace apps, emergency calls and court operations.
Government agencies in several countries reported service disruptions.

articles.title: Ukraine and Russia prepare largest-ever prisoner exchange
bullets: Zelenskyy said Ukraine and Russia would hold a major prisoner swap.
The exchange was reported amid renewed diplomatic talks in Europe.
Kyiv continued pressing allies for air-defense support.

articles.title: Zelenskyy meets NATO and European leaders in Dublin
bullets: Zelenskyy met NATO chief Mark Rutte in Dublin.
He also held talks with French and Italian leaders.
Air defense and the Ukraine war were central topics.

articles.title: Francophonie Summit opens in Phnom Penh
bullets: The 20th Francophonie Summit convened in Cambodia’s capital.
Reuters carried coverage from the Phnom Penh meetings.
The summit brought together French-speaking governments and partners.

articles.title: Italy rescues people trapped by rising river in Ventimiglia
bullets: Italian firefighters rescued 19 people from rising water.
The rescue took place in Ventimiglia after river levels climbed.
Severe weather also affected parts of southern Europe.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: India’s October retail inflation breaches RBI tolerance band
bullets: Reuters reported October retail inflation at 6.09% year over year.
Food-price pressure squeezed household budgets.
The data fueled expectations of tighter monetary policy.

articles.title: Indian shares fall as oil and inflation worries weigh
bullets: Indian equities declined Friday amid higher crude prices.
Inflation concerns offset support from foreign institutional inflows.
Foreign investors recorded a ninth straight session of net buying.

articles.title: Rupee rally faces pressure from oil and US yields
bullets: The rupee faced renewed pressure from rising oil prices.
Higher US yields supported the dollar against emerging-market currencies.
Bankers cited speculation about RBI dollar-market activity.

articles.title: Indian Express publishes November 13 national news archive
bullets: The Indian Express listed its November 13 news archive.
The archive gathered national, political and regional India coverage.
It provides a same-day index of India-focused reporting.

articles.title: Reuters reports probe into fake court-order website takedowns
bullets: Reuters found India ordered website takedowns using fake court orders.
Police launched a probe after the findings.
The report was published on November 11 and remained in India coverage.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Top US market movers and market stories

articles.title: Nvidia stabilizes after CEO resignation shock
bullets: US futures rose as investors assessed Jensen Huang’s departure.
Nvidia shares stabilized after sharp swings tied to leadership turmoil.
Markets watched possible effects on AI chip supply.

articles.title: US indexes absorb Nvidia and oil volatility
bullets: Major US indexes ended Thursday with modest losses.
AP said markets absorbed large swings in Nvidia and oil prices.
Other AI chip stocks rose even as Nvidia remained volatile.

articles.title: Nvidia selloff rattles broader tech trade
bullets: Axios reported Nvidia’s slide pressured technology stocks.
The company recently hit a multitrillion-dollar market value peak.
Investors watched how the wider AI ecosystem would trade.

articles.title: Microsoft shares pressured by global outage
bullets: Microsoft’s services outage continued affecting workplace apps worldwide.
AP said the outage had limited immediate market impact.
The stock declined in premarket trading.

articles.title: Oil-price moves remain a key market focus
bullets: AP reported oil swings contributed to Thursday’s market volatility.
Rising crude also pressured international markets and inflation expectations.
Investors monitored Middle East tensions and inventory data.

articles.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO
bullets: Nvidia said Jensen Huang resigned after a widening personal and security scandal.
CFO Colette Kress became interim CEO.
The departure triggered questions about Nvidia’s AI leadership.

articles.title: Nvidia faces post-Huang succession challenge
bullets: AP said Nvidia must find a way forward without its longtime CEO.
Huang built Nvidia into a central AI infrastructure company.
Analysts are watching customer confidence and chip-supply continuity.

articles.title: AI industry weighs fallout from Nvidia scandal
bullets: AP reported rivals may try to exploit Nvidia’s uncertainty.
The scandal raised concerns about AI-sector concentration.
Nvidia competitors include AMD, Intel, Broadcom and cloud providers.

articles.title: Binance theft recovery puts crypto security in focus
bullets: US officials seized $1.2 billion tied to stolen Binance cryptocurrency.
The broader Binance theft totaled about $6.3 billion.
Authorities linked the attack to North Korea’s TraderTraitor group.

articles.title: Microsoft outage disrupts global business operations
bullets: Microsoft’s workplace software outage entered a second day.
Businesses, police services, courts and AI tools reported disruptions.
Microsoft said it was making progress restoring services.

articles.title: Microsoft 365 outage hits Outlook, Teams and Copilot
bullets: A widespread Microsoft outage affected Outlook and related services.
The disruption spread across business and government users worldwide.
Microsoft said recovery work was continuing Friday.

articles.title: Outlook outage causes widespread email failures
bullets: Users reported trouble accessing Outlook and Microsoft apps Thursday.
The outage affected email and other Microsoft 365 services.
AP reported errors across the company’s app suite.

articles.title: Nvidia enters post-Jensen era for AI
bullets: Axios said Nvidia’s leadership change tests the AI boom.
The company remains central to AI chips and financing.
Investors are watching whether customers diversify suppliers.

articles.title: Nvidia security concerns intensify after CEO exit
bullets: AP reported Huang’s resignation followed concerns involving personal relationships and security.
Lawmakers scrutinized Nvidia’s exposure to China-related risks.
The episode may increase calls for stricter chip export controls.

articles.title: FBI crypto seizure highlights North Korean hacking threat
bullets: The FBI seized cryptocurrency stolen from Binance.
Investigators tied the wider hack to a North Korean group.
The theft ranks among the largest crypto heists reported.
